run.corun.tiering: a cell co-runs iff its lane has no solver-side wall option (the hven lanes: SolveBudget counts iterations, not seconds, so the watchdog is the only clock) and it is not named solo; external lanes (ipopt, snopt) and --solo-problems cells run SOLO in a serial tier after the co-run tier; a co-run cell that ends dnf_wall or error is discarded and re-run SOLO, and only the solo row is reported
